description: The graph illustrates the relationship between accuracy and s_pop frequency (scaled by 10^4), with accuracy plotted on the y-axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 and s_pop frequency on the x-axis ranging from 1 to 19. Two distinct lines are shown: a dashed blue line with circular markers and a solid green line with triangular markers, both accompanied by error bars. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.72 when s_pop frequency is 1, rises to a peak of 1.0 at a frequency of 9, dips slightly to around 0.88 at 13, and then remains at 1.0 for frequencies 15 and 17, maintaining this value at 19. The green line begins at an accuracy of about 0.36 at a frequency of 1, increases to approximately 0.68 at 7, drops to around 0.46 at 9, rises again to about 0.68 at 11, decreases to roughly 0.54 at 13, then drops to 0.52 at 15, and finally surges to 1.0 at a frequency of 17, where it remains at 19. The error bars indicate variability in the measurements, with the blue line showing relatively smaller error bars compared to the green line, especially at higher frequencies.
